user.title: Connect to LINE OA Gateway
user.description: Enter the URL of your LINE OA Gateway and an API key created in the Gateway Web UI. If a Gateway runs on this Home Assistant host (port 8790), the URL is filled in automatically. LINE login itself is managed in the Gateway Web UI, not in Home Assistant.

data_description.url: Base URL of the Gateway, for example http://192.168.1.50:8787
data_description.api_key: Gateway API key created in the Gateway Web UI. This is not a LINE password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure LINE OA Gateway
reconfigure.description: Change the Gateway URL or API key. Leave the API key empty to keep the current one.

data_description.url: Base URL of the Gateway, for example http://192.168.1.50:8787
data_description.api_key: New Gateway API key. Leave empty to keep the current key.

reauth_confirm.title: Gateway API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The LINE OA Gateway at {url} rejected the API key. Enter a valid Gateway API key. (If only the LINE login expired, sign in again in the Gateway Web UI instead.)

data_description.api_key: Gateway API key created in the Gateway Web UI.

discovery_confirm.title: LINE OA Gateway found
discovery_confirm.description: A LINE OA Gateway was found on your network at {url}. Enter the API key created in the Gateway Web UI to finish setup.

data_description.api_key: Gateway API key created in the Gateway Web UI. This is not a LINE password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Gateway. Check the URL and that the Gateway is running.
error.invalid_auth: The Gateway rejected the API key.
error.invalid_response: The Gateway returned an unexpected response (missing instance_id?).
error.invalid_url: Enter a full http:// or https:// URL without credentials, query or fragment.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one LINE OA Gateway can be configured.
abort.wrong_gateway: This URL belongs to a different Gateway (instance_id does not match). Add it as a new integration instead.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovered Gateway does not respond.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The Gateway announcement could not be used.

send_text.name: Send text
send_text.description: Sends a text message to one LINE recipient alias configured in the LINE OA Gateway.

who.name: Recipient
who.description: Recipient alias configured in the LINE OA Gateway. A single alias only; use a LINE group alias to notify several people.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to send. Templates are supported.

send_image.name: Send image
send_image.description: Sends a JPEG or PNG image file from the Home Assistant file system (for example /media) to one LINE recipient alias. Images are sent without text; use Send text for a message.

who.name: Recipient
who.description: Recipient alias configured in the LINE OA Gateway. A single alias only.

image_path.name: Image path
image_path.description: Absolute path of a JPEG/PNG file on the Home Assistant system (max 10 MiB). Must be inside an allowed directory such as /media.

send_screen_shot.name: Send camera screenshot
send_screen_shot.description: Takes a fresh still image from a camera entity and sends it to one LINE recipient alias. The image is kept in memory only and is sent without text.

who.name: Recipient
who.description: Recipient alias configured in the LINE OA Gateway. A single alias only.

not_loaded.message: The LINE OA integration is not set up or not loaded.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to the LINE OA Gateway ({error}). The message was not sent.

gateway_unreachable.message: Cannot reach the LINE OA Gateway: {error}

invalid_api_key.message: The LINE OA Gateway rejected the Home Assistant API key. Re-authenticate the integration.

status_failed.message: Could not read the LINE OA Gateway status: {error}

alias_not_found.message: LINE recipient alias "{who}" was not found in the LINE OA Gateway.

line_session_expired.message: The Gateway's LINE login has expired. Sign in again in the Gateway Web UI. The message was not sent.

line_auth_required.message: The Gateway is not signed in to LINE. Sign in in the Gateway Web UI. The message was not sent.

rate_limited.message: Too many requests to the LINE OA Gateway; try again later (retry after: {retry_after}). The message was not sent.

gateway_payload_too_large.message: The LINE OA Gateway rejected the image as too large.

gateway_unavailable.message: The LINE OA Gateway is temporarily unavailable. The message was not sent.

endpoint_not_found.message: The LINE OA Gateway does not support this API endpoint. Check the Gateway version.

gateway_rejected_request.message: The LINE OA Gateway rejected the request: {reason}

send_unknown.message: The LINE message send result is unknown; it may already have been sent. Do not retry immediately. (request_id: {request_id})

image_path_not_absolute.message: Image path "{path}" must be an absolute path, for example /media/snapshot.jpg.

image_not_found.message: Image file "{path}" does not exist or is not a regular file.

image_path_not_allowed.message: Access to "{path}" is not allowed. Use a file inside /media or a directory listed in allowlist_external_dirs.

image_invalid_format.message: "{path}" is not a JPEG or PNG image.

camera_image_failed.message: Camera {entity_id} could not provide a current still image. Nothing was sent.

camera_image_too_large.message: The still image from camera {entity_id} is larger than 10 MiB.

camera_image_invalid_format.message: Camera {entity_id} returned an unsupported image format ({content_type}); only JPEG and PNG are supported.
